sourceText: Kuna fukwe nyingi, kutokana na kukaliwa magamaga kwa kwa bandari mbili na Auckland. Maarufu zaidi ziko katika sehemu tatu.
referenceText: There are many beaches, due to Auckland's straddling of two harbours. The most popular ones are in three areas.
